init_pix2pix_model: initialize a Pix2PixModel with a name, model type, dataset mode, direction, and optional checkpoint directory
load_zoo_model_weights: load a pretrained state dict into the Pix2PixModel generator network using init_zoo_model
convert_color_to_normal: run a color image through the Pix2PixModel and get a normal map output via color_to_normal
preprocess_image_for_model: convert a torch tensor image to a PIL Image and apply pix2pix transforms using preprocess_image
create_model_input_dict: build a model input dictionary with A and B image tensors and path placeholders using _create_model_input
